requirements.evidence: Schema matches the spec: database/migrations/2026_10_29_044500_create_entities_table.php:17 (`unique('entities_slug_unique')`) and ..._create_entity_memberships_table.php:18-25 (`role` default `employee`, `owner_seq` storedAs, `entity_memberships_entity_user_unique`, `entity_memberships_one_owner`). Contract items all present: app/Models/Entity.php:23-55 (slug route key, memberships/users/owner), app/Models/EntityMembership.php:26-67 (cast + local scopes), app/Models/UserRole.php:4-16, app/Models/User.php:27-54, factories, both policies (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:14-56, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:14-58). Tenant dispatch is exactly 0->onboarding / 1->set session / >1->switcher with 403 for a foreign session entity (app/Http/Middleware/ResolveCurrentEntity.php:24-39) and is wired to `/home` and the dashboard (routes/web.php:23-42). Onboarding implements unique numbered slugs, a 5-attempt insert-time retry, creator-is-owner in one transaction, the exact audit line and redirect (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:24-81, app/Actions/CreateEntity.php:20-30). Switcher markup matches the required buttons (resources/views/entities/switcher.blade.php:8-15), navbar link is conditional (resources/views/layouts/default-page.blade.php:11-13), and both locales carry the agreed texts. Docs and CHANGELOG are updated. Edge cases (soft-deleted slug stays taken, reserved `switcher`, accents, DB rejecting a second owner) are handled.

conventions.evidence: Follows the project's patterns: the domain write is an Action that authorizes internally (app/Actions/CreateEntity.php:20-30), Livewire uses `#[Validate]` + `$this->validate()` (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:24,35), all authorization goes through policies, migrations are generated-style with reversible `down()`, fillables are explicit (app/Models/Entity.php:14, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:12), and the views reuse `x-form-field`, `x-button` and `layouts::default-page` (resources/views/livewire/entity/create-entity.blade.php:6-9). Docs/CHANGELOG updated. Deviation: the custom `current_entity` middleware on the Livewire dashboard route is not registered with `Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware()`, contrary to Livewire rule 6 (app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:9-16, routes/web.php:40-42).

security.evidence: Authorization is server-side everywhere: app/Http/Controllers/EntityPickController.php:18 (`Gate::authorize('view', $entity)`), app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:23, app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:32, app/Actions/CreateEntity.php:20; the dashboard entity is `#[Locked]` (Dashboard.php:15) and the role is server-fixed (CreateEntity.php:46-48). Input is validated (CreateEntity.php:24) and output escaped with `{{ }}` (resources/views/entities/switcher.blade.php:11,13). Mass assignment is constrained by `#[Fillable]` (Entity.php:14, EntityMembership.php:12). Limited gap: because `current_entity` is not persisted for Livewire requests, membership is only re-checked in `mount()`, so a user removed from the entity while the page is open could still re-render the locked snapshot (no actions, no additional data, so impact is small).

tests.evidence: Five new Pest files cover the change end to end: tests/Feature/EntityDataModelTest.php:31-160 (named indexes, second-owner rejection, employee default, cascade, casts/scopes, membershipFor), tests/Feature/EntityPoliciesTest.php:21-108 (every ability plus outsider denial, owner-role/owner-delete protection), tests/Feature/CurrentEntityTest.php:19-219 (guest and unverified redirects, 0/1/many dispatch by role, 403 for foreign session/dashboard, exact switcher classes and `data-current`, pick audit + session untouched on 403, locked-property tamper), tests/Feature/CreateEntityTest.php:40-175 (happy path, validation, guest, role tamper, numbered slugs, soft-deleted slug, insert-time collision retry and give-up with no partial entity), tests/Feature/EntityLocalizationTest.php:7-38 (both locales). Tests assert behavior, not just status, and none are weakened.

simplicity.evidence: Minimum that works: one Action per use case, small models and policies, a 30-line TenantContext (app/Tenancy/TenantContext.php:12), and reuse of existing Blade components and the default-page layout rather than new ones. The slug retry lives in the component as the contract requires; no speculative service/repository layers. Only redundancy is the double `create` authorization.

readability.evidence: Clear domain names and a short docblock on each public method (e.g. app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:49-58, app/Models/Entity.php:23-55), small focused methods, and no dead code, debug output or unrelated style drift. The middleware and TenantContext read top-to-bottom and explain the 0/1/many dispatch.

scope.evidence: Everything in the diff serves the task: models, enum, policies, factories, migrations, middleware/tenant context, the three controllers, two Livewire components, switcher/navbar views, routes, translations, docs and CHANGELOG. `resources/views/home.blade.php` is deleted only because `/home` no longer renders it, and nothing from the out-of-scope list (members/settings pages, Accept-Language middleware, navbar redesign) is included.

issues.explanation: The dashboard's custom `current_entity` middleware is not registered with `Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware()`, so it stops applying on Livewire update requests (Livewire rule 6); impact is limited because the component exposes no actions and `mount()` authorizes the locked entity, but the fix is a one-line registration.
`create` is authorized twice, once in the component and again inside the action; the component check is redundant with the action's own authorization.

A user with zero memberships who opens `/e/{slug}` is redirected to onboarding instead of receiving the 403 described for the dashboard; this follows the middleware's empty-session rule but differs from the dashboard requirement.

The ER node for the now-implemented `entities` table still lists `locale_default`, which the migration does not create; the new 'Implemented tables' section is accurate, so the diagram is just slightly misleading.

review.summary: This change implements the whole entities slice: schema with DB-enforced single owner, models/enum/policies/factories, the tenant middleware and session dispatch, Livewire onboarding with insert-time slug retry, the switcher, a minimal dashboard, the navbar link, both locales and updated docs, all backed by thorough Pest coverage including unauthorized and tamper cases. It is close to mergeable; the only real convention gap is that the Dashboard's custom `current_entity` middleware is not persisted for Livewire requests (authorization happens only in `mount()`), plus a few minor nits.
